answer.rationale: Two of three current problems (activation down 6%, onboarding completion down 4%) are internal funnel issues that onboarding simplification has previously and directly addressed (memory_31, memory_86), making it the most defensible single-experiment bet toward sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing (memory_73) is tempting given the competitor's price move, but the original record shows booked revenue growth (18%) lagging new-account growth (31%), implying lower revenue-per-account among price-sensitive signups plus 12 cohorts of exposure to buyers who may be equally swayed by the next lower price - a downstream value/retention risk that needs verification before committing scarce experiment capacity to it. I want to verify memory_73 to check the original cohort's margin and retention detail, and memory_86 to confirm the onboarding lift was durable and not a one-time artifact, before finalizing on onboarding as the safer lever this week. Given competing signals and unverified pricing risk, I'm keeping this as a small guarded test rather than a broad rollout.
